attchmntText: Manaksia Aluminium Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding approved and adopted the standalone & consolidated Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. '.
voiceSummary: Manaksia Aluminium Company Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 12 November 2026. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was 26,435.61 lakhs. Net profit after tax was 420.37 lakhs. Earnings per share was 0.64 rupees. Total assets stood at 56,428.92 lakhs as at 30 September 2026. The statutory auditors are M/s Dangi Jain & Co. The auditor's report includes an emphasis of matter regarding uncertainties relating to certain GST assessment orders. The company has filed appeals against these orders. Management believes no material liability is likely to arise. The results are subject to publication in newspapers and on the company website.
